contract.scope: Cold complete ECDLP correctness and cost-vector smoke test; tiny groups only; no calibrated normalized-operation speedup claim.
contract.domain: Same distinct nonzero raw x-subspace factor support as the stage experiment. Project whole verified relations by the cofactor into the prime subgroup. Equal/negated projected factor columns are identified; projected identity is known zero.
contract.collection: R=s*A for a verified full-order A; after cofactor projection, row rhs is s mod N relative to G=h*A. Secrets are never supplied to decomposition.
contract.individual: R=Q+t*A; projected relation gives L=h*k+t mod N, hence k=(L-t)/h mod N. Verify [k]G=Q.
contract.accounting: Cold wall timer includes field/curve setup, enumeration and generator checks, factor-base setup, unsuccessful attempts, both solver and adapter verification, scalar elimination, and final recovery. Field API operations are split from scalar modular add/multiply/invert calls; conversions and total normalized S remain unmeasured.
contract.rho: Independent three-partition Floyd walk on the identical prime subgroup; randomized restarts and final scalar check. No factor-base precomputation. Small-group measurements are smoke controls, not extrapolation.
contract.acceptance: Every completed scalar must match the planted test scalar and satisfy [k]G=Q. Preserve missing completions and exceptions. No end-to-end claim from timing or an incomplete operation vector.
